name: KuCoin Spot Orders – Filled Orders (CSV)
description: KuCoin 'Spot Orders – Filled Orders' from the history export (kucoin.com: Orders > Spot Orders > Export, or Account > Export History > Spot Orders (Filled Orders); CSV from the ZIP). Header UID, Account Type, Order ID, Symbol, Side, Order Type, Avg. Filled Price, Filled Amount, Filled Volume, Filled Volume (USDT), Filled Time(UTC+08:00), Fee, Maker/Taker, Fee Currency (a Tax column may appear). The time header names the zone chosen at export ('Filled Time(UTC+02:00)') and is honoured. One row per order holds both legs: the base asset of the pair (Filled Amount, out on SELL) and the quote asset (Filled Volume, the other way); the fee is booked in Fee Currency. Known limits: deposits, withdrawals, transfers and Earn are in the account history (see the KuCoin account history mapping); Convert orders, margin and futures have their own files and are not covered.
